args.title: Verification record — two-site decision package at e631160
args.body: Re-read the committed package and independently re-derived the decision from the accepted sources plus the 2026-11-04 corridor survey. `node check.mjs --final` passes 46 assertions: corridor 1,050 mm in force (the survey supersedes HF-A-114's 1,250 mm); North Ridge selects K-900 because S-1080 is rated only to -16 C against the -18 C design minimum; Harbor Flats selects K-900 because S-1080 is 1,080 mm against the measured 1,050 mm corridor; H-1320 is excluded because its certificate is expected, not current, and its quote expired 2026-09-30. Cost is USD 536,000 (two lines of 250,000 + 18,000), schedule is 14 weeks from 2026-11-05 to install start 2027-02-11 with clearly labelled installation/commissioning assumptions, and the risk review records the survey, Halcyon certificate, quote expiry, C4 evidence gap and execution assumptions. No expenditure is approved. The formal task was retired as redundant because the package was already delivered as a direct commit; its never-started attempt was closed as a successor with no delta.
